rationale.edition: 11 of 12 changed files live in OSS paths (web/src/** and src/api/**). One file — o2_enterprise/src/enterprise/common/config.rs — lives in the enterprise repo and adds the recorder_extension_url config key consumed by the OSS frontend via /config. The feature spans both editions (OSS UI + enterprise config), so edition is 'both'.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. No explicit opt-out label or skip comment is present. The diff adds two new Vue components (ExtensionSetupChecklist, ExtensionSetupDialog), modifies the BrowserJourney Record/Replay gating to open a modal, and replaces inline setup steps in CreateBrowserTest with the new checklist — all user-facing UI flows that warrant E2E coverage.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The change introduces a structured, multi-step extension setup flow: an install button linking to the Chrome Web Store, an incognito toggle, a live connection-status indicator, and a dialog that gates Record/Replay on both extension readiness and incognito confirmation. Without E2E coverage, regressions in the dialog gating logic or checklist wiring would be invisible.
rationale.area: Synthetics — all UI changes live under web/src/components/synthetics/ and web/src/views/synthetics/. No existing Playwright test folder or CI matrix shard exists for Synthetics; this is a new area.
rationale.group: Synthetics — this is a new group. No Synthetics shard exists in ci_matrix.ent.json, ci_matrix_env.json, or any other matrix file. The Engineer must add a new 'Synthetics' shard to the appropriate matrix manifest (ci_matrix.ent.json for enterprise-only, or ci_matrix.json in OSS for shared).
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The three .spec.ts files changed (ExtensionSetupChecklist.spec.ts, BrowserJourney.spec.ts, ExtensionSetupDialog.spec.ts) are all Vitest unit tests under web/src/components/synthetics/ — they exercise component logic in isolation, not end-to-end browser flows. No files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ were changed.
